# Re-fetch all spam threads and build full verification table for planned actions

# login gmail
pw_gmail = [x['password'] for x in apis.supervisor.show_account_passwords() if x['account_name']=='gmail'][0]
access_token = apis.gmail.login(username='mar_blac@gmail.com', password=pw_gmail)['access_token']

# login phone + get roommate emails
pw_phone = [x['password'] for x in apis.supervisor.show_account_passwords() if x['account_name']=='phone'][0]
ptok = apis.phone.login(username='3539110281', password=pw_phone)['access_token']

contacts=[]
page_index=0
page_limit=20
while True:
    res = apis.phone.search_contacts(access_token=ptok, query='', relationship='roommate', page_index=page_index, page_limit=page_limit)
    if not res:
        break
    contacts.extend(res)
    page_index += 1
roommate_emails=set([c.get('email') for c in contacts if c.get('email')])

# fetch all spam threads (paginated)
all_spam=[]
page_index=0
page_limit=20
while True:
    page = apis.gmail.show_spam_threads(access_token=access_token, page_index=page_index, page_limit=page_limit)
    if not page:
        break
    all_spam.extend(page)
    page_index += 1

print('Total spam threads:', len(all_spam))

# Build per-thread action plan
plan=[]
for t in all_spam:
    eid=t['email_thread_id']
    subject=t.get('subject')
    participants=t.get('participants',[])
    participant_emails=set([p.get('email') for p in participants if p.get('email')])
    overlap=sorted(list(participant_emails & roommate_emails))
    is_roommate = len(overlap)>0
    planned_unspam_read_unread = is_roommate  # per task
    plan.append({
        'email_thread_id': eid,
        'subject': subject,
        'participant_emails': sorted(list(participant_emails)),
        'roommate_overlap_emails': overlap,
        'will_unspam_and_mark_unread': planned_unspam_read_unread,
        'will_delete': True
    })

# Summaries
roommate_spam_ids=[p['email_thread_id'] for p in plan if p['will_unspam_and_mark_unread']]
all_spam_ids=[p['email_thread_id'] for p in plan]

print('Roommate-spam threads to unspam+unread:', len(roommate_spam_ids), roommate_spam_ids)
print('All spam threads to delete:', len(all_spam_ids))

# Print verification table (compact)
for p in sorted(plan, key=lambda x: x['email_thread_id']):
    print(p)

# Additionally show thread details for roommate-spam threads BEFORE actions

    print('BEFORE show_thread for', eid, 'spam=', th.get('spam'), 'read=', th.get('read'), 'subject=', th.get('label'))
